name: Clear Thumbnails Cache
description: Clears the Windows thumbnail cache used by File Explorer to preview images, videos, documents, and folders. This can help fix missing or outdated previews; note that thumbnails may load more slowly for a short time while Windows rebuilds them.

description_i18n.en: Clears the Windows thumbnail cache used by File Explorer to preview images, videos, documents, and folders. This can help fix missing or outdated previews; note that thumbnails may load more slowly for a short time while Windows rebuilds them.
description_i18n.de: Leert den Windows-Thumbnail-Cache für Vorschaün in der Datei-Explorer-Anwendung. Dies kann fehlende oder veraltete Vorschaubilder beheben, wobei die Ladezeit kurzzeitig zunehmen kann, bis neue Thumbnails erstellt werden.
description_i18n.fr: Vide le cache des miniatures utilisé par l'Explorateur de fichiers pour afficher les aperçus d'images et de documents. Cela peut corriger des prévisualisations manquantes ou obsolètes ; notez que la charge peut augmenter temporairement pendant la reconstruction.

warnings.title: Thumbnail loading delay
warnings.message: File Explorer may refresh during the process. Thumbnails may load more slowly for a short time while Windows rebuilds them, especially in large media folders

warnings.title: Local data cleanup
warnings.message: Cache or temporary data may be removed. Windows or apps may take a moment to rebuild it

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Removes thumbnail cache database files from the current user profile where accessible, specifically targeting thumbcache* files in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer Windows and File Explorer rebuild preview data automatically when folders are opened again
